readings.moment: When the temple bell struck nine at dinner, Félix's watch showed twenty minutes to nine.
The temple struck nine at dinner, when everyone took out their watch.
The temple struck ten while Félix was in the library.
When the temple struck ten, Félix's watch showed twenty to ten.
Someone went quickly up the stairs past the library door.
Félix heard a thump on the floor right above him, in the atelier.
After the thump, Uncle's repeater struck ten slow deep notes.
Someone came quickly down the stairs.
The temple struck eleven, when Félix and Bastien stopped sitting together in the library.

durations: Félix's watch was twenty minutes slow at nine: it showed 8:40 when the temple bell struck 9:00.
Félix's watch was twenty minutes slow at ten: it showed 9:40 when the temple bell struck 10:00.
Uncle's repeater was made over four years (the four years of making it).
Félix and Bastien sat together in the library from 10:32 until the temple struck eleven, about 28 minutes.
whereabouts: At dinner, Félix was at the table with the others when the temple struck nine.
The Uncle was at dinner and made a scene about Félix's watch in front of everybody.
The Doctor and the Girard fellow were at dinner, where the Uncle asked Félix about his father's watch.
After dinner, Félix went up to the library and stayed there.
In the library, Félix drank brandy alone.
Félix was in the library when the temple struck ten.
At 10:15 someone went quickly up the stairs past the library door; Félix did not see who.
Félix was in the library, one floor below the atelier, when the thump came from the atelier.
At 10:21 someone came quickly down the stairs; Félix did not see who.
Bastien came into the library at 10:32.
Félix and Bastien sat together in the library until the temple struck eleven.
